liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Chinatown Shuffle** (1 review): Reviewer says Pigpen's singing is weak and wails out of tune here [11]
- **Black Throated Wind** (1 other source): The Tapers Compendium says set one ended after this song, with Jerry announcing a very short break [3]
- **Playin' In The Band** (1 other source): The count-in to Playin' was moved from the end of disc 1 to the start of disc 2 [1]
- **One More Saturday Night** (1 other source): Bobby bids the crowd goodbye at the end of this song [2]
- **It Hurts Me Too** (1 review): Reviewer praises Pigpen's performance on this song [11]
- **Caution (Do Not Stop on Tracks)** (1 review): An old Deadbase review reportedly describes the Caution as smoking, suggesting the music survives elsewhere [8]

## Setlist highlights

- Earliest performances in the archive: He's Gone [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-04-17.sbd.sirmick.34038.sbeok.flacf** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 176 min; rated 5/5 by 7 [1]
- **gd1972-04-17.sbd.ashley-field.34032.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 176 min; rated 4.71/5 by 14 [2]. Said about its sound: The source transfer had over 100 digital glitches; over 16 hours of fixes left a few small ones [2]
- **gd1972-04-17.sbd.sirmick.34224.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 176 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd1972-04-17.sbd.GEMS.33802.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 176 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [4]
- **gd72-04-17.sbd.vernon.9390.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 94 min; rated 4.23/5 by 22 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer, who has the video, calls the sound quality great [11]

## Around the show

- French television broadcast footage of the show exists and has circulated as a DVD download [9]
- Mr. Charlie is believed not to have been played that night [4]
- Dark Star through the end of the 4/14/72 show circulates widely and shows Pigpen in classic form [13]
- Reviewer finds the show lacks long jams, consisting mostly of short songs [16]
- Reviewer claims the best Good Lovin' was played at Tivoli in 1972, perhaps the next day [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-04-17.sbd.sirmick.34038.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by SirMick; source: This is a clean up of shnid 33802. [1]. Also: This transfer repairs digital errors on disc 3 and removes small gaps between tracks on discs 1 and 2 [1]
- **gd1972-04-17.sbd.ashley-field.34032.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: Bertha Remaster of the Multi-Track Master Reel Source (SHN ID 338020 [2]. Also: Remastered with the Bertha Digital Audio Workstation, finished April 14, 2006, from a flawed transfer [2]
- **gd1972-04-17.sbd.sirmick.34224.flac16**: transferred by SirMick; source: sbd > 16 track 2" MR>DAT4x > Delta Dio 2496 > Soundforge > wav > Cd Wave Editor > flac > wav > flac [3]. Also: Further clean-up of shnid 33802; a stubborn glitch near 0:42 in China Cat was patched with a 36 ms sample from shnid 9390 [3]
- **gd1972-04-17.sbd.GEMS.33802.sbeok.flac16**: source: SBD>16 track 2" MR>DAT4x>Delta Dio 2496>Soundforge>WAV>Cd Wave Editor>Flac [4]. Also: GEMS seed from April 2006 presents several songs in a different order than previously thought correct [4]
- **gd72-04-17.sbd.vernon.9390.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>??>French TV Broadcast>C>DAT>CDR [6]. Also: The version of this soundboard widely circulating on etree is missing tracks; Reviewer heard only a few people hold the full show and were told not to circulate it [8][12]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Hana Gustafson: ['Grateful Dead Meet-Up at The Movies' to Feature Copenhagen 1972 Tivoli Hall Performance](https://jambands.com/news/2022/09/15/grateful-dead-meet-up-at-the-movies-to-feature-copenhagen-1972-tivoli-hall-performance/) [20]
